answer.book: Single work with front matter: Rodolphus Goclenius's Apologeticus pro astromantia discursus (Marburg, 1611), with a title page, a dedication to the magistrates, a preface, the main discourse Pro astrologia (with subsections on planetary dignities and debilities), and a closing colophon and errata.
